subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Absorption and Half-Life
description: A micro-lesson that makes Absorption and Half-Life usable.

hook.text: Caffeine is absorbed incredibly fast—99% of it enters your bloodstream within 45 minutes of drinking.

buildup.text: Peak blood levels hit around 1 hour. Then the liver starts breaking caffeine down using the enzyme CYP1A2.

discovery.text: Caffeine's half-life averages 5–6 hours. Half the caffeine from your 3 PM coffee is still in your brain at 9 PM.

twist.text: Genetics vary this dramatically. Some people clear caffeine in 2 hours; others take 10. Same dose, different experience.

climax.text: Smoking doubles caffeine clearance speed. Pregnancy doubles the half-life. Oral contraceptives slow it further.

punchline.text: Same cup, different bodies, wildly different effects. Genes decide.

quiz.question: What is caffeine's average half-life in the body?

details.summary: Caffeine is almost completely absorbed in the stomach and small intestine within 45 minutes. Its half-life averages five to six hours in most adults, meaning half the caffeine from a morning cup is still circulating by early afternoon.
details.whyItMatters: Knowing caffeine's half-life helps people time their intake to avoid sleep disruption and plan their energy throughout the day.
takeaways: Caffeine is nearly fully absorbed within 45 minutes of drinking
The average half-life is five to six hours in healthy adults
Afternoon coffee can still affect sleep quality that night

faq.question: What factors influence how long caffeine stays in your system?
faq.answer: Genetics, liver enzyme activity, age, medications, pregnancy, and smoking all affect caffeine metabolism. Some people clear caffeine in three hours while others take over nine hours for the same dose.

faq.question: Why is it recommended to stop drinking coffee by early afternoon?
faq.answer: With a five to six hour half-life, a 2 PM coffee still has half its caffeine active at 7 or 8 PM. This residual caffeine can delay sleep onset and reduce deep sleep quality even if you fall asleep on time.
